headline: Saudi-led coalition intercepted two drones heading for the southern region
dek: Reuters: the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed two drones launched toward Saudi Arabia's southern region (22:12 GMT Oct 22); no attribution of launcher, no casualties/damage reported. Separately, Yemen's internationally recognized government's military media center posted video…
sources: Reuters (via anewz live tracker); Al Jazeera liveblog (Yemen army media center)
fault_line: Are the Ansar Allah attacks working — or is the coalition swatting them down while Yemen's government advances on the ground?

sections.what_happened: Reuters: the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed two drones launched toward Saudi Arabia's southern region (22:12 GMT Oct 22); no attribution of launcher, no casualties/damage reported. Separately, Yemen's internationally recognized government's military media center posted video claiming drone strikes on Ansar Allah barracks and combat vehicles in al-Jawf (north) and on southern fronts, under 'Operation Dawn of Yemen' (announced Oct 4; offensive launched Oct 5 to retake Sanaa). Both items missed by the 0300 scan.
sections.what_verified: Intercepts: Reuters single-wire (via anewz tracker) — no independent second source this window. Yemen army video: the government's own military media account (primary-source claim), no independent verification of hits.
sections.what_disputed: No attribution given for the two drones; Ansar Allah claims (Yahya Saree: four attacks in 48h on Riyadh/Dammam/Yanbu/Abha) are the group's own claims, unverified. The al-Jawf strike footage is unconfirmed by any independent outlet.
sections.why_matters: Theater update only: two drones down, no damage — the attrition continues on both sides. Keep as running-log context for the next real development.
sections.context: Background: CAUGHT-UP: Saudi-led coalition intercepted two drones heading for the southern region (Reuters, 22:12 GMT Oct 22); Yemen government posts "Dawn of Yemen" drone-strike video on Ansar Allah positions
